description: This file declares external functions related to retrieving configuration parameters by name, such as ULONG, string, boolean, and instance number, used within the Cosa (Component Object-based Service Architecture) framework for DSL home model management.

methods.name: CosaGetParamValueUlong
methods.description: Retrieves an ULONG parameter value given its name.

methods.name: CosaGetParamValueString
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value given its name, storing it in a provided buffer.

methods.name: CosaGetParamValueBool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter value given its name.

methods.name: CosaGetInstanceNumberByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the instance number corresponding to a given object name and index.
